content.text:
* Precision NMOS-input folded-cascode OTA with a dominant output pole.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Reference: bias current sets a low-side mirror and cascode offset.
RB IBIAS BN 40k
XBR BN BN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XTAIL TAIL BN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=64 l=2 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS input pair.
XINP FP VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=3 nf=1 m=2
XINN FN VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=3 nf=1 m=2
* High-side current bias, nominally 32 uA in each signal branch.
XBP PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=25 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XBN PB BN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPSP FP PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XPSN FN PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=4 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS cascode bias holds the input drains below VDD by about 0.3 V.
RPC VDD SPC 30k
XBPC PC PC SPC VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XBNC PC BN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPCP ND PC FP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=48 l=4 nf=1 m=2
XPCN VOUT PC FN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=48 l=4 nf=1 m=2
* Wide-swing cascoded NMOS mirror.
XNMR NR ND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=64 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNMO NO ND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=64 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNCR ND IBIAS NR VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=64 l=4 nf=1 m=1
XNCO VOUT IBIAS NO VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=64 l=4 nf=1 m=1
* Output compensation and filtered low-side cascode bias.
CDOM VOUT VSS 16p
CBN IBIAS VSS 4p
.ends DUT
